title: u1-timeline-engine: pure date/geometry engine for the projects timeline
scope: lib/projects timeline engine: projectEffectiveStartISO (start_date ?? semester start for classes ?? createdAt date-part), window/zoom scale math for weeks|months|quarters (px-per-day, column derivation, header labels), bar geometry (clamping, open-ended ends, min-width, start>end corruption guard), drag math (px->date with per-zoom snapping), area grouping + ordering (orderIndex,createdAt; sentinel No Area last), archived/expired classification reuse. Pure functions, ISO-string date math only, exhaustive unit tests in lib/projects/__tests__/. No UI, no page edits.
criteria: projectEffectiveStartISO resolves start_date ?? semester start (classes) ?? createdAt date-part
Zoom scales (weeks/months/quarters) produce correct columns, px-per-day, header labels
Bar geometry handles: open-ended (null end), clamping to window, start>end corruption guard, min width
Drag math: px->ISO date with per-zoom snapping (day/day/week), pure and tested
Area grouping ordered by orderIndex,createdAt with sentinel No Area last
All date math ISO-string based; zero new Date("YYYY-MM-DD") parsing; pnpm --filter web test green
